title: Create: Aeronautics Experience
description:
A lightweight Create-based modpack focused on Aeronautics.
Build, fly and explore with smooth performance and a clean, relaxing experience.
body:
# ✈️ Create: Aeronautics Experience

**A lightweight, chill-focused modpack built around Create and Aeronautics, designed for relaxed engineering, flying machines, and exploration.**

- 🌍 Gameplay Focus
- ⚙️ Build and automate with Create
- ✈️ Design and fly machines using Aeronautics
- 🌄 Explore enhanced terrain and structures
- 🌿 Enjoy a calm, progression-friendly survival experience
> Create-based mechanical gameplay,
> Aeronautics flying and airship building,
> Farmer’s Delight for simple cooking and food progression,
> Exploration tools for easier navigation,
> Improved world generation and structures,
> Light ambient enhancements for immersion
